notable_absence.finding: A bare reserved-keyword table (roughly 100 tokens, e.g. ALL, DATASET, DATAVERSE, SHADOW, FEED, RTREE) with no prose, no links, and no per-keyword explanation. Per the round's own guidance, a keyword list has no concepts to extract - left empty deliberately rather than minting one concept per keyword, which would be disproportionate. Worth noting for reconciliation: DATASET, DATAVERSE, SHADOW and FEED are reserved here specifically because they are Analytics-specific DDL nouns (analytics:shadow-collection is already an extraction-layer concept from the Capella round), evidence that the keyword list is downstream of the dialect's own object model rather than a generic SQL reservation.
